- [S1] Atlas design study for this topic (docs/75). The body is one adult male reference anatomy, simplified; the bench models (a nerve cell, a synapse, a slice of spinal cord, the layers round the brain, a one-metre nerve drawn half size) are enlarged or shortened and not to scale. Design values: a thick fibre with myelin carries a signal at 100 metres per second, a thin fibre without it at 1 metre per second (both inside the published ranges, S20); over one metre that takes 1 m ÷ 100 m/s = 0.010 s = 10 ms and 1 m ÷ 1 m/s = 1 s = 1,000 ms; the screen shows both in 2 s, so the thick fibre is slowed 2 s ÷ 0.010 s = 200 times and the thin one 2 s ÷ 1 s = 2 times. Ruler drop: a ruler caught after falling d centimetres has fallen for t = √(2d ÷ 9.81 m/s²) (free fall from rest; S43); for d = 20 cm, t = √(0.40 ÷ 9.81) = 0.202 s ≈ 202 ms; the card lists every centimetre from 3 to 20 cm and every 2 cm from 22 to 30 cm, rounded to whole milliseconds. Bench magnifications: the nerve cell about 4,000 times (a cell body of about 25 micrometres drawn about 10 cm), the synapse about 40,000 times, the spinal-cord slice about 12 times; the layers round the brain are drawn thicker than they are, not to any one scale. The reflex arm turns 20 degrees at the elbow, slowed down. Measured in the model: the reflex signal's route from the fingertip to the spinal cord in the neck is 0.95 m long (scripts/anatomy/brain-nerves/routes.json), which at 100 m/s takes 0.95 ÷ 100 = 0.0095 s ≈ 10 ms. / 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（docs/75）。身体是一个成年男性参考解剖模型，已简化；工作台上的模型（一个神经细胞、一个突触、一片脊髓横切、包着脑的几层、画成一半长的一米神经）是放大或缩短的，不按比例。设计值：粗的、有髓鞘的纤维每秒传 100 米，细的、没有髓鞘的每秒 1 米（都在已发表的范围内，S20）；走一米分别要 1 米 ÷ 每秒 100 米 = 0.010 秒 = 10 毫秒，1 米 ÷ 每秒 1 米 = 1 秒 = 1,000 毫秒；画面上两者都用 2 秒走完，所以粗纤维放慢了 2 ÷ 0.010 = 200 倍，细纤维放慢了 2 ÷ 1 = 2 倍。尺子接落：尺子落了 d 厘米才被接住，下落的时间 t = √(2d ÷ 9.81 米/秒²)（从静止自由下落；S43）；d = 20 厘米时 t = √(0.40 ÷ 9.81) = 0.202 秒 ≈ 202 毫秒；卡片列出 3 到 20 厘米（每 1 厘米一档）和 22 到 30 厘米（每 2 厘米一档），取整到毫秒。工作台的放大倍数：神经细胞约 4,000 倍（约 25 微米的细胞体画成约 10 厘米），突触约 40,000 倍，脊髓横切约 12 倍；脑外的几层画得比真实厚，没有统一比例。反射时手臂在肘部转 20 度，画面放慢了。在模型上量：反射信号从指尖到颈部脊髓的路线长 0.95 米（scripts/anatomy/brain-nerves/routes.json），按每秒 100 米算要 0.95 ÷ 100 = 0.0095 秒 ≈ 10 毫秒。 (Not a measurement. Inputs: S20 (conduction speeds), S43 (standard gravity), S6 (neuron parts), S24 (axon length). / 不是测量值。依据：S20（传导速度）、S43（标准重力）、S6（神经元的结构）、S24（轴突长度）。) (design study / 设计研究)

## Model sources and downloads (hand-written)

The 3D model `public/models/brain-and-nerves.glb` (CC BY-SA 4.0; full attribution in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`):

| Part of the model | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Cerebral cortex (lobes) | Anderson Winkler, Brain for Blender (brainder.org), as adapted in Z-Anatomy; confirmed against the original Destrieux parcels | CC BY-SA 3.0, adapted under CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Cerebellum | BodyParts3D 4.0, FMA67944 | CC BY 4.0 |
| Brainstem, ventricles, dura, nerves, roots, cauda equina, skull, spine, right arm, other bones | Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Cranial nerves, optic pathway, hearing nerve | Z-Anatomy, crediting University of Dundee CAHID Cranial Nerves and Foramina | CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Body outline | the heart-and-lungs model (Z-Anatomy) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Spinal cord, corpus callosum, bench models, helmet, eye and ear markers | drawn by Atlas (engine primitives) | — |

Not used: the Z-Anatomy cerebellum and spinal-cord outline (no attributable source; scripts/anatomy/brain-nerves/provenance.md), the Dundee inner ear (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), the University of Washington white-matter models (licence not found).

Downloads (2026-11-15, gitignored `scripts/anatomy/cache/`): `NervousSystem100.fbx` (53,887,724 B, sha256 3ea1aad6…f2b1) from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LluisV/Z-Anatomy/PC-Version/Resources/Models/FBX/NervousSystem100.fbx; `partof_BP3D_4.0_obj_99.zip` (64,888,505 B, 9fbc713f…1c97) from https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/data/bodyparts3d/LATEST/; Brainder `pial_Destrieux_obj.tar.bz2` (8,952,441 B, b8297630…f55b) and `subcortical_obj.tar.bz2` (3,382,528 B, a489f40e…b2b2) from https://s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/brainder/software/brain4blender/smallfiles/. The last three were used only to check where the source meshes come from, except the BodyParts3D cerebellum.

## Source rules for this topic (hand-written)

- OpenStax books are not cited (their pages bar ingestion by generative AI); facts that came only from them were replaced by other sources or cut (docs/75 §15.4).
- NCBI Bookshelf pages showed a human-verification page and were not read; StatPearls' CSF volume is replaced by Chudler (S28) and Johanson 2008 (S29).
- Facts cut for want of a readable source: the spinal cord stopping its growth after the first year or two; brain mass 1.3–1.4 kg; the pons regulating breathing; a hard helmet shell spreading the force; the cerebellum comparing intended and actual movement; the triceps being inhibited in the withdrawal reflex.
